nuisance_model: exact causal per-NORAD rates with Gaussian fitting prior and profiled per-track CFO
geographic_objective: equal-group mean exact cap-800 data loss; nuisance prior excluded
transition_rule: recenter at unchanged spacing only when the raw cap-800 winner is on the symmetric 3x3 edge; halve after the full-spacing basin closes
qualification_rule: both group fits converge, both 0.2 Hz exact-SGP4 gates pass, and the final half-step winner is interior
postseal_policy: the geographic reference may be read only after inference.json is sealed
